CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_staff()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.staff_profiles s
    where s.user_id = auth.uid() and s.active = true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_hotel_paid_reservation(p_hotel_id uuid, p_vehicle_type_id uuid, p_entry_at timestamp with time zone, p_days integer, p_plate text, p_model text, p_customer_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_phone text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_email text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ declare v_available integer;v_id uuid;v_reference text;v_control bigint;v_exit timestamptz; begin if not private.is_staff() then raise exception 'No autorizado';end if; if p_days<1 or p_days>24 then raise exception 'Duración inválida';end if; perform 1 from public.parking_hotels where id=p_hotel_id and active for update; if not found then raise exception 'Hotel inexistente';end if;select available_days into v_available from public.parking_hotel_balances where id=p_hotel_id;if v_available<p_days then raise exception 'Bonos insuficientes';end if;insert into public.reservations(vehicle_type_id,entry_at,duration_days,customer_name,customer_phone,customer_email,plate,vehicle_make_model,status,payment_status,payment_method,amount_eur,manual_price_override,source,notes,created_by,hotel_id) values(p_vehicle_type_id,p_entry_at,p_days,nullif(trim(p_customer_name),''),nullif(trim(p_phone),''),nullif(trim(p_email),''),upper(trim(p_plate)),upper(trim(p_model)),'confirmed','paid','hotel_voucher',0,false,'admin',nullif(trim(p_notes),''),auth.uid(),p_hotel_id) returning id,reference,manual_control_number,exit_at into v_id,v_reference,v_control,v_exit;insert into public.parking_hotel_redemptions(reservation_id,hotel_id,days) values(v_id,p_hotel_id,p_days);return jsonb_build_object('id',v_id,'reference',v_reference,'manual_control_number',v_control,'amount_eur',0,'entry_at',p_entry_at,'exit_at',v_exit,'payment_method','hotel_voucher','remaining',v_available-p_days);end $function$

more.balance_view:
SELECT id,
    name,
    active,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(b.days) AS sum
           FROM parking_hotel_batches b
          WHERE b.hotel_id = h.id), 0::bigint)::integer AS purchased_days,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(x.days) AS sum
           FROM parking_hotel_redemptions x
          WHERE x.hotel_id = h.id), 0::bigint)::integer AS used_days,
    (COALESCE(( SELECT sum(b.days) AS sum
           FROM parking_hotel_batches b
          WHERE b.hotel_id = h.id), 0::bigint) - COALESCE(( SELECT sum(x.days) AS sum
           FROM parking_hotel_redemptions x
          WHERE x.hotel_id = h.id), 0::bigint))::integer AS available_days
   FROM parking_hotels h;
